editionLabel: Jumbo English rules in the 2018 multilingual booklet
firstPlayerRule: The player who has, at some point, traveled closest to the Forbidden City in China starts.
clarifications: This is Jumbo’s tile-laying Forbidden City by Reiner Knizia, not the separate game Gùgōng.
